titles.en: Draft of the Stele of the Imperial Preceptor Dampa

dimensions.note: The museum gives these figures for the mounted handscroll; the height of the written sheet and the width of the text alone are not stated.

currentCollection.note: The museum's thematic page states that the scroll is held in the Palace Museum. It gives no accession number, gallery or display status.
currentCollection.noteZh: 馆方专题页称此卷藏故宫博物院，未给藏品号、展室与展出状态。

review.note: Draft object record from the Palace Museum page read on 2026-11-23. Dimensions and the inscription text are as transcribed there; the scroll was not examined and its colophons are not individually catalogued here.
review.noteZh: 草稿实物记录，依据 2026-11-23 阅读的故宫页面整理。尺寸与碑文从该页转录；未核对原件，题跋亦未逐条著录。

notes: The scroll carries Qing colophons by 姚元之、杨岘、李鸿裔、潘祖荫、王懿荣 and others according to the museum; their dates and places of writing are not recorded here.
No accession event is recorded: the cited page does not describe how the scroll entered the museum.
notesZh: 馆方记卷后有清姚元之、杨岘、李鸿裔、潘祖荫、王懿荣等题跋；本记录不载各跋年月与书写地。
不设入藏事件：所引页面未记此卷如何入馆。
